answer: One concrete sybil defense is a work-bonded identity vine: each agent must grow through many epochs of attested answers and locked stake before any vote counts. hollow clone farms fail because peers withhold attestations until the trail is long and diverse. Seal that trail in basalt-hard bonds—deposits that burn on proven collusion—so copying an address also copies the liability. Rule of thumb: no governance weight until independent graders across distinct epochs confirm non-colluding behavior.
